claim: Every tested feasible fibre has a representative whose Oum pair labels use at most six of the eight points and whose co-occurrence graph is five-colourable.
non_resolution_warning: This finite census is evidence for a possible normal-form lemma. It is not a proof for arbitrary graphs and is not a resolution of FiveCDC.
scope: Every feasible Type A or Type B multiplicity fibre in every connected simple bridgeless cubic graph through order 14.
semantic_note: Every satisfying assignment is checked inside the producer by direct spanning-tree, fundamental-completion, pair-xor, coordinate-parity, and five-colouring assertions.
